recentItems.title: Exploring tech power behind global trade, services at CIFTIS in Beijing
recentItems.description: The 2026 #CIFTIS at Beijing's iconic Shougang Park continues to unveil tech surprises. From a robotic "service" dog to AI business tools and immersive cultural experiences, join Xinhua for a glimpse into the future of global services.

recentItems.title: Inside CIFTIS 2026: Where global services trade meets tech innovation
recentItems.description: The 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS) is in full swing at Beijing's Shougang Park. Join us for a tour of the fair to explore how tech-driven trade in services is improving our daily lives. #CIFTIS #ChinaTech #Innovation

recentItems.title: How China's services trade moves up value chain, shares opportunities
recentItems.description:
What are companies selling at the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS)?
Not just products, but ideas, technologies, solutions...
More than a showcase of what's on offer, the fair provides a glimpse into how China expands opening-up and advances high-quality development in its services trade.

recentItems.title: CIFTIS 2026｜Exploring highlights & talking to international visitors
recentItems.description: CIFTIS 2026 is underway in Beijing. Follow us to visit key exhibition zones and explore highlights in digital, green and cultural services trade.

recentItems.title: Reporter boards fire-hit cargo ship in Qingdao following rescue operations
recentItems.description: A foreign cargo ship caught fire Thursday while undergoing maintenance in China's Qingdao, leaving 25 people dead. After rescue operations, Xinhua went aboard the vessel for a closer look. #China #CargoShip #OnSite

recentItems.title: How AI is reshaping everyday services at CIFTIS
recentItems.description: At a services trade fair in Beijing, AI is expanding into a wide range of real-world applications. From healthcare and tourism to education, these technologies are enhancing user experiences while opening up new opportunities for international cooperation.
